headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-0 shutout victory over the Miami Marlins, with Gabriel Rincones Jr. leading the Marlins' offense. The Washington Nationals took down the Kansas City Royals 7-3, led by Dylan Crews' home run and three RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Mets 12-0 behind Chase Burns' strong performance, while the St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their team's availability. Brad Keller has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis, while Daniel Palencia is out with right elbow inflammation. Angel Martínez is on the 10-day injured list with a left foot non-displaced fracture, and Corey Seager is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins were defeated 7-0 by the Philadelphia Phillies in a one-sided matchup. Gabriel Rincones Jr. led the Marlins' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Dylan Crews leading the offense. Crews hit a home run, driving in three runs, while Andrew Alvarez pitched 4 strong innings with 5 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Mets 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Mets, securing a 12-0 victory behind a strong performance from Chase Burns, who pitched 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Shut Out Padres 3-0**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, with Dustin May earning the win after pitching 9.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Brad Keller on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Brad Keller has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm tendinitis, with the move retroactive to June 14, 2026. The Phillies will assess Keller's condition as he undergoes treatment for the injury.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
